atopic_dermatitis.name: Atopic Dermatitis (Chronic Eczema)
atopic_dermatitis.pathophysiology: Driven by a Th2 cytokine cascade leading to epidermal barrier disruption and increased transepidermal water loss.
atopic_dermatitis.doctor_notes: Look for typical distribution in flexural areas. Differentiate from psoriasis by the absence of silvery scales.

strep_throat.name: Acute Bacterial Pharyngitis (Strep Throat)
strep_throat.pathophysiology: Colonization of the pharyngeal mucosa by Streptococcus pyogenes, triggering an acute inflammatory response in the lymphatic tissues.
strep_throat.doctor_notes: Presence of tonsillar exudates strongly suggests bacterial over viral etiology.
strep_throat.interventions: First-line therapy with Penicillin or Amoxicillin.

myocardial_infarction.name: Acute Myocardial Infarction
myocardial_infarction.pathophysiology: Occlusion of a coronary artery leading to transmural ischemia and subsequent myocardial necrosis.
myocardial_infarction.doctor_notes: Urgent evaluation of ECG for ST-segment elevation. Immediate reperfusion is critical to save myocardium.
myocardial_infarction.interventions: Emergency PCI (Percutaneous Coronary Intervention) or Thrombolytics.
